suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific injury complication. Apply to documented non-freezing cold injury with persistent objectively supported sensory neuropathy. Do not generalize this source to all freezing injuries or every cold-injury residual phenotype. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Cold Injuries (Frostbite / Immersion Foot Residuals) matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Peripheral Neuropathy with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Apply to documented non-freezing cold injury with persistent objectively supported sensory neuropathy. Do not generalize this source to all freezing injuries or every cold-injury residual phenotype.
